items.description: Kala'ngozi is a risk, project and procurement management consultancy at Stand 1055, Heritage Hill Estate, Louwlardia, Centurion. The company's name comes from Zulu, combining "kala" (to measure or weigh) with "ingozi" (danger or risk), reflecting its focus on capital procurement, risk management, project management and project assurance. It serves organisations in Centurion and beyond that need specialist consulting on large capital projects, procurement decisions or project risk, rather than general business consulting. Kala'ngozi suits companies and institutions undertaking significant capital projects who need dedicated risk, procurement or project-assurance expertise, with the exact industries and project types it has worked on best confirmed directly with the consultancy.

Montigroei is a manufacturer and supplier at Unit 18, Tannery Industrial Park, 309 Derdepoort Road, Silverton, Pretoria, with its own factory shop on the premises. It distributes its products to private hospitals, hotels, restaurants, schools, canteens and senior homes, as well as selling directly to private buyers through the factory shop. It serves institutional buyers across the hospitality, healthcare and education sectors that need a reliable supplier, alongside members of the public who can buy directly from the Silverton factory shop. Montigroei suits both institutional customers needing regular supply and individual buyers who want to purchase directly from the factory rather than through a retailer, with its specific product range best confirmed with the business.

Netcare Medicross Silverton is a branch of the Medicross medical and dental centre network at 310 Pretoria Road, Silverton, Pretoria. Medicross centres bring together general practitioners, dentists and other healthcare professionals under one roof, giving patients access to several types of care at a single location rather than visiting separate practices. It serves residents of Silverton and the surrounding Pretoria area who need to see a doctor, dentist or other healthcare professional. As part of the Netcare group, Medicross Silverton follows the network's established multi-disciplinary medical-centre format, giving patients in Silverton convenient access to several healthcare services at once. Patients can typically see several healthcare providers in one visit without travelling between separate practices across the city, which can save time for families managing more than one type of appointment.

Pretoria Ceilings and Drywalling Contractors Pty Ltd is a women-owned construction contractor at 360 Coetzee Street, Garsfontein, Pretoria, delivering professional drywall installations, ceiling solutions and related supplies. The team emphasises precise workmanship, quality finishes and reliable project management on its jobs. It serves homeowners and businesses in Garsfontein and the surrounding Pretoria East suburbs who need ceiling or drywall work done for a renovation, new build or office fit-out. Pretoria Ceilings and Drywalling Contractors suits customers who want a specialist drywall and ceiling contractor rather than a general builder, for both residential and commercial projects. The team's focus on quality finishes and careful project management is aimed at reducing the disruption and mess that ceiling and drywall work can cause in an occupied home or working office.

Ramz Shuttle Services is a privately black-owned shuttle and transport company at 439 Suikerbos Road, Thatchfield Estate, Centurion. It operates with a dedicated management team focused on continuous, reliable delivery of its transport service, aiming for safe, secure journeys for its passengers. It serves individuals and businesses in Thatchfield and the surrounding Centurion area who need shuttle transport, whether for regular commuting, airport transfers or other point-to-point travel. Ramz Shuttle Services suits customers in Centurion looking for a locally based, independently owned shuttle operator for their transport needs, with its specific routes and rates best confirmed directly with the company.

Ridge Pharmacy is a community pharmacy at Shop 17, Sinoville Corner, 284 Braam Pretorius Street, Sinoville, Pretoria, offering everyday medicines, health products and pharmacy services. It serves residents of Sinoville and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs who need to collect prescriptions or buy medicines and healthcare products while already at Sinoville Corner. The pharmacy trades every day of the week, from 8:30am to 6pm, giving customers a consistent daily window including weekends, unlike many pharmacies that close or reduce hours on Sundays. Ridge Pharmacy suits Sinoville residents who want a pharmacy with full seven-day trading hours close to home. Being located inside Sinoville Corner also makes it an easy stop for shoppers already visiting the centre for groceries or other errands, rather than needing a separate trip elsewhere for medicine or health products.

Roots Butchery is a quality meat retailer and wholesale butchery at 30 Olifantsfontein Road, Olievenhout Plaza, Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, part of the Roots Group. It serves a wide range of clients, from individual retail customers buying meat for the household to larger industry buyers needing wholesale supply, positioning itself on the quality of its meat and other products. It serves households in Olievenhoutbosch and the surrounding Centurion area doing everyday meat shopping, as well as businesses that need a wholesale meat supplier. The branch trades Monday to Saturday from 8am to 7pm and Sunday from 8am to 5pm. Roots Butchery suits both home cooks and commercial buyers looking for a dedicated quality meat supplier rather than a general supermarket butchery counter.

Roseville Cafe and Take Away is a café and takeaway outlet at 599 Smook Avenue, Roseville, Pretoria, serving residents of Roseville and the surrounding suburbs who want a casual meal or a quick takeaway order. It trades every day of the week from 11am to 10pm, giving customers a long daily window that covers both lunch and dinner. Roseville Cafe and Take Away suits local residents looking for a nearby, everyday café and takeaway option rather than travelling to a shopping centre for a meal, with its specific menu best confirmed directly with the outlet. Its long daily hours, running well into the evening every day of the week, make it a dependable option for a late dinner or a snack after hours when many other local options may already be closed.

Seboweng Engineering Solutions is an engineering firm at 7085 Ouhout Close, Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, working across petrochemical, building and manufacturing projects. Its petrochemical work covers practical, all-encompassing solutions for the complex requirements of petrochemical plant projects, while its building-services side offers project-management competence for structures of varying size and complexity, and its manufacturing work focuses on turning business challenges into effective engineering solutions. It serves petrochemical companies, property developers and manufacturing businesses in Centurion and the wider Gauteng area that need specialist engineering input on complex projects. Seboweng Engineering Solutions trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm, and is closed over weekends.

Shephtin Construction and Projects is a construction company at 12 Bogey Street, Waterkloof Heights, Waterkloof, Pretoria, specialising in Nutec house construction. The business is a registered company with the CIPC, and its team of experienced construction professionals focuses on delivering quality Nutec homes using what it describes as only the best materials, aiming for durability in every build. It serves homeowners and property developers in Waterkloof and the surrounding Pretoria area who want a Nutec home built, rather than conventional brick-and-mortar construction. Shephtin Construction and Projects trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, and suits clients specifically looking for Nutec construction expertise.

Shula Developers is a built-environment consulting firm at Montana Gables, 5 Escallonia Street, Montana Park, Pretoria, covering architecture, civil engineering, land surveying, programme and project management, structural engineering and town planning, alongside transactional advisory and construction services. The company also offers fleet-management services, including fuel management, a fleet management information system, full maintenance leasing, licensing and fine administration, and vehicle tracking. It serves property developers, government bodies and organisations in Montana and the wider Pretoria area that need built-environment consulting across multiple engineering and planning disciplines, as well as businesses needing fleet-management support. Shula Developers suits clients looking for a single firm spanning both built-environment consulting and vehicle fleet management.

Silverton Panelbeaters, known locally as Silverton Spuitverwers en Paneelkloppers, is a family-run panel beating and spray painting business at 201 Battery Street, Silverton, Pretoria, with 45 years of experience in the panel-beating trade. The business is committed to making the panel-beating and spray-painting process an affordable, pain-free experience for its customers, and has built a satisfied, growing client base over its decades of operation. It serves motorists in Silverton and the surrounding Pretoria area who need accident repair, spray painting or general panel-beating work done on their vehicle. Silverton Panelbeaters suits customers looking for a long-established, family-run panel shop with a multi-decade track record rather than a newer workshop.

The Beauty Connexion is a beauty salon at 1058 Pecan Avenue, Heritage Hill, Centurion, offering facials and skincare treatments including acne facials and chemical peels, alongside makeup services. Clients can book appointments in advance rather than relying on walk-ins. It serves residents of Heritage Hill and the surrounding Centurion suburbs looking for professional skincare and makeup treatments close to home. The salon trades Monday to Friday from 7am to 5:30pm, and is closed on weekends, giving clients an early-morning start before the working day. The Beauty Connexion suits clients wanting a dedicated skincare and makeup salon rather than a general hair and beauty salon.

Van Niekerk Construction is a medium-sized construction company at 10 Candlewood Close, Woodlands Estate, Pretoria, specialising in commercial, hospitality, residential and retail construction. Its experienced management team and skilled artisans form the backbone of the business, which has built up an established track record across these different types of construction projects. It serves property developers, businesses and homeowners in Woodlands Estate and the surrounding Pretoria area who need a contractor capable of handling commercial, hospitality, residential or retail builds. Van Niekerk Construction suits clients who want a single, medium-sized construction company able to take on a range of project types rather than a specialist in only one building category.

Visual Exposure is a signage and perspex manufacturing business at 142 Botha Avenue, Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, working with clients to produce signage and perspex products to the image they want to create. It serves businesses in Lyttelton, Centurion and the wider Pretoria area that need custom signage or perspex manufacturing for their premises or marketing. Visual Exposure suits businesses looking for a dedicated signage and perspex manufacturer rather than a general printing company, with its specific product range and turnaround times best confirmed directly with the business before placing an order. A signage and perspex manufacturer working directly with clients on the final look of a sign or display can be a more flexible option for a business than ordering a standard product from a large printing chain.

Void-Com is an information technology and telecommunications solutions provider at 55 Finus Road, Valhalla, Pretoria, describing itself as offering a full turnkey solution for telecommunications companies. The business has provided services to major telecommunications providers since 2007, working in multiple areas both locally and abroad, with offerings that include surveys and builds for telecoms infrastructure projects. It serves telecommunications companies and related businesses that need an experienced turnkey partner for infrastructure projects, rather than managing survey and build work with multiple separate contractors. Void-Com suits telecoms providers in South Africa and beyond looking for a provider with an established, multi-year track record since 2007.

This Woolworths branch trades from Jubilee Mall, on the corner of Jubilee Road and Harry Gwala Road, Hammanskraal, as part of the national Woolworths retail chain. It offers Woolworths' usual range of food, clothing and household products, with the branch regularly running the chain's catalogue-based promotions and specials. It serves residents of Hammanskraal and the surrounding area who want Woolworths-branded groceries, clothing or homeware without travelling further into Pretoria. The branch trades Monday to Thursday from 9am to 6pm, Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 6pm and Sunday from 9am to 3pm. As part of a national chain, its exact department mix at Jubilee Mall is best confirmed on a visit or directly with Woolworths.

ZINITHX (PTY) LTD is a software company at 281 Jeff Masemola Street, Pretoria Central, developing ZinithX Pro, an invoicing and client-management software product. The software lets businesses sign up and set up an account quickly, import or add clients and set up a product or service catalogue, then create, send and track invoices to get paid faster, without requiring complicated setup or training. It serves small and growing businesses that want to move away from manual invoicing and client-record keeping toward a dedicated software tool. ZINITHX suits businesses in Pretoria Central and beyond looking for straightforward invoicing and client-management software rather than building their own system or relying on spreadsheets.

Ackermans Gezina Galleries is a branch of the national Ackermans family-fashion chain at Shop 24, Gezina Galleries, on Michael Brink Street, Gezina, Pretoria. It is categorised as a clothing store serving women and children specifically, alongside Ackermans' broader affordable family-fashion range. It serves residents of Gezina and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs who want affordable clothing for women and children without travelling further into the city. The branch trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 3pm and Sunday from 9am to 2pm. As part of a national chain, Ackermans Gezina Galleries follows the brand's established affordable family-fashion format.

Active Transport is a moving company at 322 Domkrag Street, Waltloo, Pretoria, offering relocation services for both homes and businesses. The company operates a nationwide network of skilled, experienced movers who work together to provide a comprehensive moving service, aiming to make relocation straightforward for its customers rather than a stressful process. It serves households and businesses in Waltloo and the wider Pretoria area, as well as customers needing a nationwide move rather than a purely local one. Active Transport trades every day of the week, from 8am to 4pm, giving customers a consistent window to arrange a move seven days a week. It suits anyone needing a tailored home or business relocation handled by an established, nationwide moving company.

AM Lasercutting is a laser-cutting business at 36 Springbok Avenue, Theresapark, Akasia, producing laser-cut decorative items across a range of occasions and categories, including corporate and wedding décor, vinyl cutting, pregnancy-themed keepsakes, leather items, home décor, special events, funeral items and holiday décor. It serves individuals and businesses in Theresapark and the surrounding Akasia area planning an event, looking for personalised décor, or wanting a custom laser-cut item for a specific occasion. AM Lasercutting suits customers looking for custom, laser-cut decorative or keepsake items for weddings, funerals, holidays or other occasions, rather than mass-produced decorations, with its exact current product range and pricing best confirmed directly with the business.

BCZA is a hardware and power-tools supplier at Unit 2, Louwlardia Business Park, Louwlardia, Centurion, and South Africa's official distributor of Milwaukee power tools. It carries Milwaukee's professional-grade cordless power tools, accessories, personal protective equipment, storage systems and jobsite solutions, including the Milwaukee M18 cordless system. It serves tradespeople, contractors and businesses in Louwlardia and the wider Centurion area that need professional-grade power tools and jobsite equipment, rather than consumer-grade tools from a general hardware store. The warehouse and workshop trade Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm and Friday from 8am to 2pm. BCZA suits trade and industrial customers specifically looking for official Milwaukee tools and support in South Africa.

Bel Amour Spa is a boutique wellness spa at 152 Rabie Street, Meyerspark, Pretoria, offering personal massage treatments and restorative care. Its treatments are personalised, with pressure and focus shaped around each guest, and the spa also offers couples' sessions and half-day wellness escapes for those wanting more than a single treatment. It serves residents of Meyerspark and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs looking for massage therapy or a longer wellness escape close to home. The spa trades every day of the week, from 9am to 6pm. Bel Amour Spa suits clients looking for a boutique, personalised wellness experience rather than a larger chain spa, including couples wanting a shared treatment session.

Blinex Plastics is a manufacturer at 84 Concordia Road, Silverton, Pretoria, working in chemicals, plastic, rubber and petroleum manufacturing. Its product range includes synthetic rubber, discs, sheets and rods, along with air-filtration products, placing it in the industrial plastics and rubber components space rather than consumer plastic goods. It serves industrial and manufacturing businesses in Silverton and the wider Pretoria area that need synthetic rubber or plastic components, or air-filtration products, for their own production processes. Blinex Plastics suits manufacturers and industrial buyers looking for a specialist supplier of synthetic rubber and related plastic components rather than a general plastics retailer.

BlyNet is an online accommodation booking platform based at 190 Smuts Avenue, Lyttelton Manor, Pretoria, connecting travellers with guest houses and self-catering accommodation across South Africa. Through its website, users can explore an interactive map and browse guest houses in destinations such as the Western Cape, Eastern Cape and North West, booking a place to stay directly online. It serves South African travellers planning a trip who want to browse and book accommodation nationwide from one platform, rather than searching separate listings for each destination. BlyNet trades daily from 8am to 5pm for customer support, and suits travellers looking for a dedicated, South Africa-focused accommodation booking platform.
